cells.gaps: The Stratégie nationale du numérique 2021-2025 ended in 2025. Its successor, the National Digital Economy Strategy 2026-2030, was in preparation in September 2025 (TUN-040), and a ministry official described a six-axis national digital strategy in November 2025 (TUN-039); no adoption, text, delivery plan, governing body or finance has been found for it. The rows for the predecessor Tunisie Digitale 2020 (TUN-005 to TUN-008, TUN-035 to TUN-038) are not carried to this instrument.
cells.note: Instrument: the National Digital Economy Strategy 2026-2030, in preparation as successor to the 2021-2025 strategy whose period has ended. A lapsed strategy with a successor in preparation is stage 2; stage 3 needs the successor adopted with a public text.
